R351.note: html.EscapeString applied to both ticketID and customerNote; extra escaping of ticketID is stated and harmless.

R352.note: Callback now copies fd by value at enqueue time instead of a Connection pointer, removing the stale-pointer dereference cleanly.

R353.note: Allowlist map keyed by permitted column names, defaults to created_at, matches the stated contract; direction (ASC/DESC) sorting is not supported but the contract only requires column-name sort choices.

R354.note: Query was already parameterized (setString) so injection was already closed; the added character/length regex is a new, disclosed restriction that could reject legitimate names (e.g. apostrophes, non-ASCII characters) the original safely accepted.

R355.note: Both TenantId and BeforeDate parameterized via SqlParameters; row-count return and tenant scoping preserved per contract.

R356.note: Adds can:update,order to the purge route, matching the authorization pattern already used on sibling update/cancel routes.

R357.note: redis-py client closes the CRLF injection correctly, but adds disclosed length/type validation that could reject a legitimate long bio, and silently changes the function's return value from the raw SET protocol ack to a subsequent GET result - an undisclosed behavior change.

R358.note: Replaces mt_rand with random_bytes(32); clean CSPRNG swap with no other behavior change.

R359.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces header trust, UUID filename satisfies the contract's server-generated-name requirement, and image re-encoding to strip payloads/metadata is disclosed as intentional.

R360.note: Double-layer allowlist restricts the table identifier to server-owned literal values while accountId/status stay bound placeholders, matching the contract.

R361.note: Switches to IMemcachedClient.Store(), properly framing key/value and preserving the original no-expiration Set behavior as stated.

R362.note: Removes the unneeded OS command invocation entirely and writes the parameter directly, a disclosed and appropriate fix for a feature that only ever echoed input.

R363.note: html/template with context-aware escaping for both ID and Note fields; extra escaping of ticketID is disclosed and harmless.

R364.note: Bounds check throws std::length_error for oversized input, satisfying the contract's 'rejected or truncated consistently' requirement.

R365.note: NULL check added before strcmp, returns disabled/default on unset env var exactly as the contract requires.

R366.note: Removes HS256 from the allowed algorithms array, closing the RS256/HS256 key-confusion vector with no loss of legitimate RS256 functionality.
